body: # Calendar. ## How to use Economic Calendar. Economic Calendar on TradingView shows the latest and upcoming economic events that can affect certain assets, regions, and global markets — for example, stocks, Forex, or bonds. All events are in chronological order and linked with economic indicators like interest rates or GDP. The calendar is customizable: one click will give you a weekly economic calendar, another — narrow it down to US economic calendar only. Plus, you will see short explainers of the events and forecasts from experts. Just set your calendar and prepare for the next trade. Learn more about the Economic Calendar features in our Help Center. ## Frequently asked questions.

# Economic Calendar. Our real-time Economic Calendar keeps track of all financial events and economic indicators that drive the markets. The Economic Calendar contains a full descriptions of the events and their relative importance in affecting the market, in addition to previous, forecast and actual figures as they're announced. ### What is the Investing.com Economic Calendar? The Economic Calendar is a real-time, streaming schedule of economic events and data releases that can move financial markets. You can filter the calendar by importance level to focus on the events that matter most to you. You can also toggle the display to show either the event time or the time remaining until each announcement. We are proud to share our economic calendar with you, but would remind you that due to external factors beyond our control, Investing.com cannot be held responsible for any trading losses or other losses incurred as a result of using the economic calendar.

You can lose your money rapidly due to leverage. Please ensure you understand how this product works and whether you can afford to take the high risk of losing money. * Trading platforms Economic and trading calendar. # Economic and trading calendar. Keep your finger on the pulse of the financial markets and get a head start on your next trades with our economic and trading calendar. Discover and explore the calendar and learn about the different ways you can use it. ## How to use our economic and trading calendar. You can use our economic and trading calendar to browse or search for upcoming macroeconomic events, earnings and dividends announcements, initial public offerings (IPOs) and stock splits – there’s a dedicated tab for each. Here are some ways in which you can use the calendar:. * Select the tab for the shares-related event you’re interested in. * Search for the shares using the issuing company’s name or ticker symbol or scroll down to the date of the event.
